what: 15 bars stuck to the bottom of the screen rise one by one to cover the screen while the section comes up (its top edge from the screen bottom → 40%) — the three rightmost first, the rest in shuffled order at .01 intervals (power2.out · scrub 1). Once covered, the head’s rounded corners turn square from 30%→20%, and when the section’s bottom edge reaches 90%→80% the bottom corners become rounded, then the bars exit upward off the screen at .03 intervals with power2.in to open the next section. Section text such as Philosophy and About is placed on the bar stage

options.bars: Number of bars, default 15 (original phone is 9 — if the phone uses a different number, the user’s css hides the extra bars)
options.lead: Number of right-end bars that rise first, default 3
options.rise-start / rise-end: Rising range (section-based ScrollTrigger position), default top bottom · top 40%
options.leave-start / leave-end: Exit range, default bottom 80% · bottom top
options.--fx-z: Bar panel stacking order, default 1 — section text sits above it (z-index 2)
options.[data-fx-part=curtain]: Bar panel (child) — if empty, the part creates the bar

use: Your philosophy text here
note: The bar panel is fixed to the screen (position: fixed), so wherever it sits within a section it sticks to the bottom of the screen. With reduced-motion settings, no bar is shown and the section background is painted in the bar color
